title: Fusion Industry Association Publishes White Paper Guiding US States on Fusion Regulation
detail: The Fusion Industry Association released "Fusion Energy, Agreement States, and the Path to Effective Regulation" on September 9, 2026, alongside the Organization of Agreement States' 2026 Annual Meeting in Nashville — the same gathering where Tennessee's first-in-the-nation fusion license was showcased. Because the NRC placed fusion machines under the 10 CFR Part 30 byproduct-materials framework rather than fission reactor rules, Agreement States hold the central role in licensing fusion facilities within their borders. The paper urges states to review existing statutes for a clear, predictable licensing framework; coordinate reciprocity and joint reviews so standardized fusion machines aren't re-reviewed state by state; build regulatory staffing and technical capacity; and work with developers on activated-materials management and disposal pathways.
